action: Prepare and present the unmet-needs category data at Maria Santos's next task force session. The presentation has two parts: (1) the utilization numbers — 14 sessions, 11 participants with actionable next steps, 4 referred to Kevin's office hours, 3 to community college — which demonstrate the Financial Triage Navigator is operating and producing outcomes; (2) the 4 unmet-needs cases, anonymized and described in specific terms — what each person needed, what existing programs were checked, why none fit. These 4 cases are the gap the council can close with a targeted funding allocation. I am not asking for a large grant. I am asking Santos to support a formal application for a 20-hour-per-week part-time navigator position — roughly $1,200/month — so the function does not collapse when I am pulled into other obligations. Santos asked me to flag this. I am flagging it with a budget line attached.
